dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly concave trailing edge exhibiting a distinct falcate curvature through the mid-section toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological highest point with a wide pixel radius, categorized as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Gradual anterior margin with an approximate 35-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base-to-height ratio approximately 1.4:1 based on the visible pixel dimensions from the dorsal transition to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear white scars (likely rake marks) present on the upper flank and trailing edge of the dorsal fin. Significant irregular notches and loss of tissue integrity along the lower half of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Subtle light-gray mottling patterns on the visible mid-dorsal surface.
